tasks.short: Requisition, select and transport pipework tools and materials.

steps.what: Clarify the tradesperson's required tools, equipment, pipe specifications, quantities and work-site destination
inputs: current job drawing or material instruction
outputs: captured job material and tool requirements

steps.what: Select type and size of pipe and identify the matching tools and equipment against the specified work
inputs: captured job material and tool requirements
actual stock markings and available tools
outputs: selected pipe and tool identifiers with any shortages

steps.what: Prepare the tool and equipment requisition using native catalogue selections and reused job and site fields
inputs: selected pipe and tool identifiers with any shortages
captured job material and tool requirements
outputs: final proposed internal requisition and storekeeper destination

steps.what: Check and approve the complete tool, equipment and material requisition and intended internal storekeeper
inputs: final proposed internal requisition and storekeeper destination

steps.what: Commit the approved internal requisition to the job's stores request record
Send the approved requisition to the named internal storekeeper for issue
Collect and inspect the actual materials, tools and equipment issued for the work site
Transport the collected materials and equipment to the work site using appropriate handling methods
outputs: materials and equipment at work site

steps.what: Check the delivered load at the work site and verbally identify shortages or substitutions to the tradesperson
inputs: materials and equipment at work site
captured job material and tool requirements
outputs: actual delivered load and exceptions communicated

tasks.design: Configure native job/site reuse and catalogue fields in {PROCUREMENT} and the stores functions of {OPS_SYSTEM}. The helper still clarifies requirements, selects and checks actual items, collects and transports them; the supervising tradesperson approves the complete final requisition before separate internal commitment and storekeeper messaging through {CHAT}. Any item, quantity or destination change voids approval, no supplier order is placed, and shortages return to the tradesperson rather than being substituted by software.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requisition details are copied from work instructions into stores records and messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue selections and approved request routing can reduce repeated administration.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing actual pipe sizes and types and safely moving awkward loads.
tasks.human_edge: Check the physical items against the tradesperson's requirements and report exceptions.

ambition.what: Reduce internal requisition handling around existing material preparation.

tasks.altitude: The helper's hands-on duties and supervised role remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Use the same approved job-linked requisition rather than request a second list.

evidence.claim: Stores and purchasing systems can reuse job fields and catalogue items and route approved internal requisitions.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not observed. They include five supervising tradesperson hours; helper denominator is 95 and no outside-role saving is claimed.

The tradesperson supplies normal job instructions. s1 counts helper clarification and capture of tool/equipment need, pipe type and size, quantity, job and destination; s2 checks physical identifiers and s3 counts missing catalogue entries manually.
The requisition is an internal stores request, not an external purchase order. Existing stores issue work is unchanged and receives no savings credit.
Physical collection, transport, checks and actual shortage communication retain full time; no clean delivered-as-planned record is inferred.
unknowns: Whether native stores requisitions already reuse the required job fields.
research_questions: How much helper re-entry remains between the work instruction and stores request?

already_counted.description: Helper prepares and checks actual requisition fields.
Supervising tradesperson checks and approves the final request.

incremental.description: Maintain job/site field links and internal requisition routing.

approvals.approved_version: approved requisition version including exact items, quantities, job and internal stores target
approved requisition version including exact request and internal storekeeper destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: four helper drafting and five actual stores-message handling shares saved from95 helper shares less one upkeep point gives net8.47. Low: native stores requests remove most new benefit. Same-request-record commitment and physical handling retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Supervised pipework preparation with a clearer internal requisition path.
reach: Tradespeople and stores use the same approved request while physical handling remains with the helper.
role.ambitious_version: Spend less time repeating requisition details while preserving physical checks and safe material handling.
